finance.description: Set your daily pay rates. These will be used to calculate your weekly earnings. [Български]

finance.invoicingDescription: Choose how you handle invoicing and tax returns. Costs are deducted from your weekly standard pay. [Български]

finance.versoBasicDescription: Professional invoicing + public liability insurance (requires Ltd company) [Български]
finance.versoFullDescription: Full invoicing + accounting + tax returns + insurance (requires Ltd company) [Български]

user.displayNameHelp: This is how you'll be identified in the app [Български]

onboarding.title: Onboarding [Български]
onboarding.description: Restart the onboarding wizard to see the setup process again or take the interactive dashboard tour. [Български]

restartDialog.title: Restart Onboarding [Български]
restartDialog.description: Choose how you'd like to restart the onboarding process [Български]

dataList.mileage: Mileage tracking and pay rate history [Български]

alternatives.resetRates: You can reset your pay rates in Settings if they've changed [Български]
